description:
The workflow starts with selecting chr2:g.39417578C>G as the search term. The closest gene to the variant was found using MyVariant.info[1]. Gene expression in tumors for CDKL4 were queried from the Open Pediatric Cancer Atlas API[3]. Median expression of CDKL4 was obtained from the GTEx Portal[4] using the portal's API. To visualize the level of expression across tumor gene expression, a bar plot was created Fig.. 
1. Lelong, S. et al. BioThings SDK: a toolkit for building high-performance data APIs in biomedical research. Bioinformatics vol. 38 2077–2079 (2022). doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btac017
3. Shapiro, J. A. et al. OpenPBTA: The Open Pediatric Brain Tumor Atlas. Cell Genomics vol. 3 100340 (2023). doi:10.1016/j.xgen.2023.100340
4. Lonsdale, J. et al. The Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx) project. Nature Genetics vol. 45 580–585 (2013). doi:10.1038/ng.2653
name: Use Case 7: Variant Expression in Tumor/Healthy
tools: construct a vertical bar plot with tumor gene expression
identify the closest gene to this variant
use gtex api to obtain median tissue expression for the given gene
use kf api to obtain tumors expressing the given gene
